extraction.name: TravelPlanner
extraction.description: A benchmark for evaluating language agents on real-world travel planning with multiple constraints. It provides a sandbox environment, tools for accessing nearly four million data records, and 1,225 curated planning queries with reference plans.
extraction.creator: Jian Xie; Kai Zhang; Jiangjie Chen; Tinghui Zhu; Renze Lou; Yuandong Tian; Yanghua Xiao; Yu Su
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The benchmark was built by creating a static, closed sandbox environment backed by databases for six travel-related tools, generating diverse synthetic travel queries from randomly chosen trip elements and varying constraints, using GPT-4 to turn these elements into natural language queries, and then having 20 graduate students manually annotate feasible reference plans followed by author review and budget recalibration for quality control.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Raw/source data consisted of around four million Internet-crawled travel records stored in static databases for six tools: city, flight, distance matrix, restaurant, attraction, and accommodation search.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: Automatic evaluation of extracted plan components using predefined scripts, with metrics including delivery rate, commonsense constraint pass rate, hard constraint pass rate, and final pass rate; micro and macro evaluation strategies are used for constraint pass rates.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: GPT-4-Turbo was used to extract key components from natural-language plans for evaluation.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The benchmark includes a commonsense evaluation dimension based on the authors' consensus, which may reflect subjective bias because definitions of commonsense can differ across people.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The benchmark's commonsense evaluation is limited by subjective author-defined criteria, and use of validation/test feedback for cheating is explicitly disallowed.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset is intended to support future research on complex planning and foster innovation in language agents.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: The dataset is a benchmark for evaluating language agents on tool use and complex multi-constraint travel planning. It is split into training, validation, and test sets; evaluation feedback from the training set may be used for learning, but cheating on validation and test sets is prohibited.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The authors plan to release evaluation scripts.
